logger.doc:name: Log Completeness Failure
logger.message: HANDLED ERROR: Completeness mismatch in Run ID: #[vars.runContext.runId default 'N/A']. Reporting control preserved.

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { recordCount: sizeOf(vars.extractedRecords default []), totalAmount: sum((vars.extractedRecords default []) map ((r) -> (r.amount default 0.00) as Number)) default 0.00, customerCount: sizeOf((vars.extractedRecords default []) distinctBy ((r) -> r.customer_id default r.customerId)), completenessResult: "FAIL", checksum: "NIL_REPORT", isNilReport: false }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: vars.runContext.correlationId default correlationId, runId: vars.runContext.runId, errorType: "COMPLIANCE:COMPLETENESS_MISMATCH", status: "FAILED", message: "Completeness verification failed. Submission aborted to maintain compliance integrity.", details: error.description }

logger.doc:name: Log Archive Collision
logger.message: ARCHIVE COLLISION DETECTED: Target archive file already exists in immutable store or access was denied. Run ID: #[vars.runContext.runId default 'N/A'], Archive File: #[vars.archiveSubmissionFilePath default vars.submissionFilename default 'N/A'], Summary File: #[vars.archiveSummaryFilePath default vars.summaryFilename default 'N/A'], Write Mode: CREATE_NEW. Details: #[error.description default 'FILE_ALREADY_EXISTS']

set-variable.value: #['Archive collision error: target file already exists in immutable archive (' ++ (vars.archiveSubmissionFilePath default vars.submissionFilename default 'unknown') ++ '). Operation rejected to maintain immutable compliance archive.']
set-variable.doc:name: Set runErrorMessage

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: vars.runContext.correlationId default correlationId, runId: vars.runContext.runId, errorType: "FILE:ARCHIVE_COLLISION", status: "FAILED", message: "Archive write rejected: target file already exists in immutable archive.", archiveFile: vars.archiveSubmissionFilePath default vars.submissionFilename, entityCode: vars.runContext.entityCode, reportType: vars.runContext.reportType, sequenceNumber: vars.runContext.sequenceNumber, details: error.description }

logger.doc:name: Log Database Error
logger.message: HANDLED ERROR: Database operation failed. Error: #[error.description]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: vars.runContext.correlationId default correlationId, runId: vars.runContext.runId default "N/A", errorType: "DB:ERROR", status: "FAILED", message: "Database operation encountered a failure.", details: error.description }

logger.doc:name: Log Email Delivery Failure
logger.message: HANDLED ERROR: Email notification failed after retries. Error: #[error.description]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: vars.runContext.correlationId default correlationId, runId: vars.runContext.runId default "N/A", errorType: "EMAIL:DELIVERY_FAILED", status: "FAILED", message: "Report generated and archived, but notification dispatch failed.", details: error.description }

logger.doc:name: Log Catch-All Error
logger.message: HANDLED ERROR: Unexpected error occurred during compliance workflow: #[error.description]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: vars.runContext.correlationId default correlationId, runId: vars.runContext.runId default "N/A", errorType: "COMPLIANCE:GENERAL_ERROR", status: "FAILED", message: "Compliance processing failed unexpectedly.", details: error.description }
